verses.he: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ תָּגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִ֝שְׂמְח֗וּ אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.ar: اَلرَّبُّ قَدْ مَلَكَ، فَلْتَبْتَهِجِ ٱلْأَرْضُ، وَلْتَفْرَحِ ٱلْجَزَائِرُ ٱلْكَثِيرَةُ.
verses.en: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad.
verses.kjv: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad [thereof].
verses.web: Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

verses.he: עָנָ֣ן וַעֲרָפֶ֣ל סְבִיבָ֑יו צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מְכֹ֣ון כִּסְאֹֽו׃
verses.ar: ٱلسَّحَابُ وَٱلضَّبَابُ حَوْلَهُ. ٱلْعَدْلُ وَٱلْحَقُّ قَاعِدَةُ كُرْسِيِّهِ.
verses.en: Clouds and darkness are round about Him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.
verses.kjv: Clouds and darkness [are] round about him: righteousness and judgment [are] the habitation of his throne.
verses.web: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

verses.he: אֵ֭שׁ לְפָנָ֣יו תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וּתְלַהֵ֖ט סָבִ֣יב צָרָֽיו׃
verses.ar: قُدَّامَهُ تَذْهَبُ نَارٌ وَتُحْرِقُ أَعْدَاءَهُ حَوْلَهُ.
verses.en: A fire goeth before Him, and burneth up His adversaries round about.
verses.kjv: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
verses.web: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

verses.he: הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקָ֣יו תֵּבֵ֑ל רָאֲתָ֖ה וַתָּחֵ֣ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.ar: أَضَاءَتْ بُرُوقُهُ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةَ. رَأَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱرْتَعَدَتْ.
verses.en: His lightnings lighted up the world; the earth saw, and trembled.
verses.kjv: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
verses.web: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

verses.he: הָרִ֗ים כַּדֹּונַ֗ג נָ֭מַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֲדֹ֣ון כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.ar: ذَابَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ مِثْلَ ٱلشَّمْعِ قُدَّامَ ٱلرَّبِّ، قُدَّامَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْأَرْضِ كُلِّهَا.
verses.en: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.kjv: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.web: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

verses.he: הִגִּ֣ידוּ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם צִדְקֹ֑ו וְרָא֖וּ כָל־הָעַמִּ֣ים כְּבֹודֹֽו׃
verses.ar: أَخْبَرَتِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ بِعَدْلِهِ، وَرَأَى جَمِيعُ ٱلشُّعُوبِ مَجْدَهُ.
verses.en: The heavens declared His righteousness, and all the peoples saw His glory.
verses.kjv: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
verses.web: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

verses.he: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ ׀ כָּל־עֹ֬בְדֵי פֶ֗סֶל הַמִּֽתְהַלְלִ֥ים בָּאֱלִילִ֑ים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־לֹ֝ו כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.ar: يَخْزَى كُلُّ عَابِدِي تِمْثَالٍ مَنْحُوتٍ، ٱلْمُفْتَخِرِينَ بِٱلْأَصْنَامِ. ٱسْجُدُوا لَهُ يَا جَمِيعَ ٱلْآلِهَةِ.
verses.en: Ashamed be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of things of nought; bow down to Him, all ye gods.
verses.kjv: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all [ye] gods.
verses.web: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

verses.he: שָׁמְעָ֬ה וַתִּשְׂמַ֨ח ׀ צִיֹּ֗ון וַ֭תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנֹ֣ות יְהוּדָ֑ה לְמַ֖עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: سَمِعَتْ صِهْيَوْنُ فَفَرِحَتْ، وَٱبْتَهَجَتْ بَنَاتُ يَهُوذَا مِنْ أَجْلِ أَحْكَامِكَ يَارَبُّ.
verses.en: Zion heard and was glad, and the daughters of Judah rejoiced; because of Thy judgments, O LORD.
verses.kjv: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
verses.web: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, Yahweh.

verses.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה עֶלְיֹ֥ון עַל־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד נַ֝עֲלֵ֗יתָ עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ عَلِيٌّ عَلَى كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ. عَلَوْتَ جِدًّا عَلَى كُلِّ ٱلْآلِهَةِ.
verses.en: For Thou, LORD, art most high above all the earth; Thou art exalted far above all gods.
verses.kjv: For thou, LORD, [art] high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
verses.web: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

verses.he: אֹהֲבֵ֥י יְהוָ֗ה שִׂנְא֫וּ רָ֥ע שֹׁ֭מֵר נַפְשֹׁ֣ות חֲסִידָ֑יו מִיַּ֥ד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם׃
verses.ar: يَا مُحِبِّي ٱلرَّبِّ، أَبْغِضُوا ٱلشَّرَّ. هُوَ حَافِظٌ نُفُوسَ أَتْقِيَائِهِ. مِنْ يَدِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ يُنْقِذُهُمْ.
verses.en: O ye that love the LORD, hate evil; He preserveth the souls of His saints; He delivered them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.kjv: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.web: You who love Yahweh, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.ar: نُورٌ قَدْ زُرِعَ لِلصِّدِّيقِ، وَفَرَحٌ لِلْمُسْتَقِيمِي ٱلْقَلْبِ.
verses.en: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.kjv: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.web: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

verses.he: שִׂמְח֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הֹוד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֹֽׁו׃
verses.ar: ٱفْرَحُوا أَيُّهَا ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ بِٱلرَّبِّ، وَٱحْمَدُوا ذِكْرَ قُدْسِهِ.
verses.en: Be glad in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks to His holy name.
verses.kjv: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.web: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
